\section{Uniform product heat-kernel Laplace bounds}
\label{app:laplace}

We record the compact-space argument behind Lemma~\ref{lem:varadhan} and the
uniform estimate used in Theorem~\ref{thm:open-stability}.

\begin{lemma}[Compact Laplace bounds]\label{lem:compact-laplace}
Let $X$ be a compact metric space carrying a probability measure $\lambda$
that is positive on every nonempty open set.  Suppose $q_t:X\to(0,\infty)$
and a continuous $F:X\to\R$ obey
\begin{equation}\label{eq:uniform-log-density}
 \varepsilon_t:=\sup_{x\in X}|2t\log q_t(x)+F(x)|\longrightarrow0.
\end{equation}
Let $Q_t=q_t\lambda/\int q_t\dd\lambda$.  For every open $O$ and closed $C$,
\begin{align}
 \liminf_{t\downarrow0}2t\log Q_t(O)
 &\geq-\inf_O(F-\min F),\label{eq:ldp-lower}\\
 \limsup_{t\downarrow0}2t\log Q_t(C)
 &\leq-\inf_C(F-\min F).\label{eq:ldp-upper}
\end{align}
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
From \eqref{eq:uniform-log-density},
\begin{equation}\label{eq:exponential-sandwich}
 \exp\left(-\frac{F(x)+\varepsilon_t}{2t}\right)
 \leq q_t(x)\leq
 \exp\left(-\frac{F(x)-\varepsilon_t}{2t}\right).
\end{equation}
The upper bound for an integral over any measurable $A$ is
\[
 \int_Aq_t\dd\lambda
 \leq \exp\left[-\frac{\inf_AF-\varepsilon_t}{2t}\right].
\]
For a nonempty open $O$, choose $x\in O$ with
$F(x)<\inf_OF+\delta$.  Continuity gives a nonempty open neighborhood
$N\subset O$ on which $F<\inf_OF+2\delta$.  Since $\lambda(N)>0$,
\[
 \int_Oq_t\dd\lambda
 \geq\lambda(N)
 \exp\left[-\frac{\inf_OF+2\delta+\varepsilon_t}{2t}\right].
\]
After multiplying logarithms by $2t$, the fixed factor $\lambda(N)$
vanishes.  Letting $\delta\downarrow0$ yields the unnormalized Laplace lower
bound.  Applying the two bounds to $A=X$ shows
\[
 \lim_{t\downarrow0}2t\log\int_Xq_t\dd\lambda=-\min F.
\]
Subtracting this normalization proves
\eqref{eq:ldp-lower}--\eqref{eq:ldp-upper}.
\end{proof}

For the heat-kernel product
\[
 q_{t,s}(U)=\prod_{i=1}^m p_t(Us_i),
\]
the uniform Varadhan limit \eqref{eq:uniform-varadhan} gives
\begin{equation}\label{eq:product-uniform-limit}
 \sup_{U\in G}\left|2t\log q_{t,s}(U)+F_s(U)\right|
 \leq m\sup_{V\in G}
 \left|2t\log p_t(V)+\dist(\one,V)^2\right|.
\end{equation}
The right side is independent of $s$.  Lemma~\ref{lem:compact-laplace} with
$X=G$ and $\lambda$ equal to Haar measure therefore proves the fixed-staple
large deviation principle.

For completeness, we isolate the uniform gap consequence.

\begin{lemma}[Uniform energy gap implies uniform exponential rarity]
\label{lem:uniform-gap}
Let $K\subset G^m$ be compact, and for each $s\in K$ let $A_s\subset G$ be
measurable.  Suppose
\begin{equation}\label{eq:uniform-gap-assumption}
 \inf_{s\in K}\left(\inf_{U\in A_s}F_s(U)-\min_VF_s(V)\right)\geq\eta>0.
\end{equation}
Then there is $t_0>0$ such that
\begin{equation}\label{eq:uniform-gap-result}
 \sup_{s\in K}\gamma_{t,s}(A_s)
 \leq\exp\left(-\frac{\eta}{8t}\right),
 \qquad 0<t<t_0.
\end{equation}
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
The numerator upper bound from \eqref{eq:exponential-sandwich} is uniform by
\eqref{eq:product-uniform-limit}.  For the denominator, choose a minimizer
$U_s$ of $F_s$.  The family $(F_s)_{s\in K}$ is uniformly continuous on
$G$: for a fixed small radius $r>0$,
\[
  F_s(U)\leq\min F_s+\eta/4
  \quad\text{whenever }\dist(U,U_s)<r,
\]
uniformly in $s$.  Bi-invariance makes the Haar volume of this ball
independent of $U_s$ and strictly positive.  The denominator lower bound on
that ball and the numerator upper bound over $A_s$ leave an exponential gap
of at least $3\eta/4$, before the uniform errors in
\eqref{eq:product-uniform-limit}.  For small $t$ those errors and the fixed
ball-volume prefactor are absorbed by weakening the exponent to
$\eta/(8t)$.
\end{proof}

In Theorem~\ref{thm:open-stability}, take $K=\closure{\mathcal V}$ and
$A_s=\{U:\dist(\one,Us_m)<\rho\}$.  The neighborhood is chosen so that its
closure satisfies the same strict inequalities; the energy comparison in
that theorem verifies \eqref{eq:uniform-gap-assumption}.
